text_sections.text: [Main] Trash your top security card. Then, gain 2 memory.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[Start of Your Main Phase] Gain 1 memory.
[On Play] By trashing 1 [Shambala] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
[End of Your Turn] If you have a Digimon with the [Tentei Hachibushu] trait, by suspending this Tamer, you may use 1 Option card with the [Shambala] trait from your hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Security Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In this situation, and this card's [End of Your Turn] effect trigger simultaneously.
If you activate before attacking with a Digimon, [EX12-074 Genshi Continent & Ashino Island]'s {Security} [Your Turn] effect becomes a derived triggering effect, allowing the Digimon to digivolve into the specified card. After all processing that results from digivolving is resolved, and before the counter timing, you can activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect that is pending activation.
Related Cards

At such times, can I activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?
